title: Compare versions
subtitle: What changed between two deliveries of your IFC set — elements, IDS compliance and open BCF issues.

source.sceneEmpty: No loaded model has its IFC available. Load the files first, or pick IFC files.
source.filesHint: Select one or several .ifc files — a whole discipline set can be compared at once.
source.baselineEmpty: No saved baselines yet. After a comparison, save the new version as a baseline to compare next week's delivery against it.

unreadable: Some entities could not be read — the comparison covers the rest of the file.

changes.empty: Choose both versions and press Compare.
changes.duplicates: Duplicated GlobalIds (before: {{base}}, after: {{head}}) — those elements are compared once only.
changes.noGeometry: Geometry was not compared: position and shape changes are not included.
changes.legend: 3D colours: blue = added, amber = modified, red = removed (only visible when the old version is loaded). Everything else is ghosted.

baseline.saveHint: Keep the new version in this browser to compare next week's delivery against it.

report.title: IFC version comparison
report.subtitle: {{base}} → {{head}} · {{date}}
report.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} changed elements — the CSV export has all of them.

ids.runTitle: Check both versions against an IDS
ids.runHint: The same IDS runs on the before and after sets. Failures are followed by GlobalId, so you see which were resolved and which are new.

derive.title: Generate an IDS from a delivery
derive.hint: Learns your standard from the model itself: every property, material and classification that (almost) all elements of a class carry becomes a requirement. Use it to hold next week's delivery to this week's level.
derive.useAndRun: Use as active IDS and check
derive.nothing: No common requirement found with these settings.
derive.description: Generated from the content of a model delivery. Review before sharing.

bcf.author: Author
bcf.updateHint: {{total}} issues in the BCF panel, {{linked}} point at elements. Each one gets a comment saying what happened to its elements in the new version.
bcf.applyStatus: Mark as Resolved the {{count}} whose elements are gone or fixed
bcf.nothingToUpdate: No open issue points at elements. Import a .bcfzip in the BCF panel to update it.
bcf.createTitle: Create issues for the new version
bcf.createHint: One issue per IDS specification with new failures, and optional review issues grouped by class and storey.

text.unchanged: No change to these elements in {{label}}.

history.title: Timeline of baselines
history.hint: Each saved baseline is a delivery. Tick two to compare them. Baselines stay in this browser; export them to share with your team.
history.label: Baseline

dock.start_one: {{count}} change — tap › to go through it
dock.start_other: {{count}} changes — tap › to go through them

rc.title: Revision compare
rc.subtitle: Drop the old revision and the new one. The comparison starts by itself.

drop.hint: Drop IFC files here or tap to choose

rc.local: Processed in your browser: files never leave this device.
rc.advanced: Weekly deliveries, baselines, IDS and BCF →
rc.keys: J / K next · R reviewed · S affects site · F frame
rc.paused: Validation and IDS colours are paused while comparing.
rc.guidRegenerated: The designer regenerated the element IDs: elements were matched by mark and position. Check the confidence of each match.
rc.originShift: The whole model moved {{x}}, {{y}}, {{z}} mm (east, north, up). That shift is ignored when classifying.

filter.marks: Marks, names or IDs (paste a list)

tol.title: Tolerances
tol.hint: Recalculated from the revisions already read; the files are not read again.

export.pdfHint: Report with a capture per change
export.bcfHint: Issues for the designer, one per change

tour.title: Revision compare tour
tour.offer: New here? A 2-minute tour shows what to look at.

local.title: Old vs new, nothing uploaded
local.body: A is the old revision, B the new one. Both are read in this browser: the files never leave your computer.

list.title: Every change, ordered by impact
list.body: Moved and removed elements first, then shape, then data. J / K or the arrows go through them one by one.

moved.title: What moved, and how far
moved.body: The arrow in 3D goes from the old position to the new one, and the sentence says it in site terms, like “Moved 120 mm W”.

table.title: Before and after
table.body: Position, size, height and changed properties side by side, with the difference. No need to open both files.

review.title: Mark what you checked
review.body: “Reviewed” when it is fine, “Affects site” when it changes work on site. The counter at the top keeps the tally.

filters.title: Only your floor, only your pieces
filters.body: Filter by storey, discipline, element type or piece mark. Paste a list of marks to see only those.

views.title: Slider A | B
views.body: Drag the line across the model: old on the left, new on the right. Or flip between A and B in the same view.

export.title: Send it on
export.body: A PDF or spreadsheet for the site team, a BCF file for the designer — every change with its picture.

end.title: Try it with your own files
end.body: ◀ Back opens the two drop zones: old revision, new revision. And tell us what you think: Help / Feedback is always here.
